name_note: The GTDB species s__Coprococcus aceti holds genomes carrying the NCBI names Coprococcus eutactus and Coprococcus aceti; the literature cited here concerns Coprococcus eutactus.

sentences.text: Coprococcus eutactus is a butyrate-producing bacterium of the phylum Bacillota, formerly Firmicutes, found in the human colon.
Strain ART55/1 of Coprococcus eutactus was able to metabolise carob galactomannan, konjac glucomannan and acetylated galactoglucomannan from softwood spruce.
In a metagenomic study of dyslipidemia, Coprococcus eutactus was described as a producer of short-chain fatty acids involved in lipid regulation and was more prevalent in controls.
A metagenomic meta-analysis of frailty identified Coprococcus eutactus among core symbionts showing progressive attrition.
